title: Record page
summary: One record shown and edited on a page: the fields read as a pk-field-list, or as a validated pk-form in edit mode, beside sidebar cards of summary fields (pk-detail-layout, which collapses on a phone). Set load(id) and save(values) as properties (business logic, never config data). load runs when config.id is set and shows the built-in loading, not-found and error (with Retry) states; without an id the page is a new record, in edit mode. save runs only after client validation passes; reject with { errors: { field: message } } to mark fields inline, or any other error for a notice above the form. While edits are unsaved, dirty is true, pk-record-dirty fires, and closing or reloading the tab asks first.

props.name: config
props.description: { id?, fields, sidebar?, heading?, saveLabel?, editable?, label?, emptyHeading? }. fields is [{ name, label?, type?, required?, readonly?, help?, options? }]: type is a pk-input type (text, email, number, date...), 'textarea' or 'select' (options: strings or { value, label }). sidebar is [{ heading, fields: [names] }], one card each. id selects the record to load; none means a new record. editable: false hides Edit. Optional title bar from the shared page shell: title?: string (the page heading; config.heading titles the field list), breadcrumb?: [{ label, href? }], actions?: [{ key, label, href?, variant?, hint? }] (a hint shows as a tooltip on the button) (an action without href fires pk-action). Nothing is drawn when none is set.

props.name: mode
props.description: view reads the record; edit shows the form with Save and Cancel. Edit and a successful save switch it; a new record is always in edit mode.

props.name: dirty
props.description: The form differs from the last loaded or saved values. Read it; the element sets it.

events.name: pk-action
events.description: A title-bar action (config.actions entry without an href) was clicked.

events.name: pk-record-dirty
events.description: The unsaved-changes state changed. An app that owns its router uses it to confirm before leaving.

events.name: pk-record-save
events.description: save() resolved; values are the saved record.

parts.name: header
parts.description: The shared title bar: a pk-page-header with the breadcrumb and actions from config. Hidden when config sets none of them.

parts.name: layout
parts.description: The pk-detail-layout holding the main column and the sidebar.

parts.name: main
parts.description: The field list or the form.

parts.name: bar
parts.description: Wraps the Edit, Cancel and Save buttons.

parts.name: cancel
parts.description: The Cancel button (edit mode of an existing record).

parts.name: save
parts.description: The Save button (edit mode); busy while save() is in flight.

parts.name: notice
parts.description: The save error, above the form.

parts.name: state
parts.description: The loading, not-found or load error state, in place of the record.

writes.target: the pk-field elements the form builds in this element's own shadow tree
writes.why: A save that rejects with { errors } sets each named field's error, and the next save clears them. The fields are rebuilt with the form, so nothing outlives the element.

a11y: Fields are labelled pk-field controls; pk-form moves focus to the first invalid field and lists the problems in a summary, and a server error focuses its field. The loading and error states use pk-skeleton and pk-alert's own roles and announcements.

examples.title: Product record (set config, load and save from script: an inline script cannot run under this site's CSP)
